$comment: DTM 2010 over the era base (bases/dtm-era3). Cars weighed 1,050 kg including the driver: 905 kg once the engine is taken off. Qualifying was a knockout in four parts; the game runs three, and the final single-lap shootout of the top four is not possible (wishlist A5, A6).
